entities.name: Tivit
entities.description: Sphinx rogue from Capenna, a seer for the Obscura known as the Seller of Secrets.

entities.name: Obscura
entities.description: Sphinx family for which Tivit is a seer.

entities.name: Raffine
entities.description: Sphinx demon leader whom Kamiz serves.

entities.name: Angels
entities.description: Possible senders of the stained glass halos.

events.summary: Kamiz and Queza visit Tivit and receive a prophecy that ripples through all the city's seers; Tivit collapses.
events.quote: As the vision ended, Tivit collapsed

events.summary: Kamiz reports to the furious Raffine, who suspects an outside force targeted the seers.
events.quote: suggesting an outside force had targeted the city's seers

events.summary: Tivit's shop is attacked, nearly killing Queza.
events.quote: nearly killing Queza, who narrowly escaped

events.summary: Kamiz removes Queza from the case after a clash over interpreting the events.
events.quote: Kamiz removing Queza from the case

relations.quote: They are a seer for the Obscura
